name: gmail-attachments
description: Download and read Gmail file attachments (PDF, image, CSV, docx, xlsx, etc.). The gmail-mcp tools only return email body text; this skill calls the Gmail REST API to fetch attachment bytes. Works on local Mac via ~/.gmail-mcp/ files, or remote VMs (Cowork, CI) via GMAIL_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/REFRESH_TOKEN env vars.
